This paper studies random quick-sort protocols in the presence of malicious adversaries and makes the following twofold contributions. · In the first fold, a new notion which we call verifiably randomized quick-sort protocols is introduced and formalized. · In the second fold, an efficient implementation of the primitive from homomorphic commitment schemes is proposed and analyzed. We show that our implementation is provably secure assuming that the underlying homomorphic commitment scheme is statistically hiding and computationally binding in the common reference model.

articleTitle: Classified Real Time Scheduling Mechanism in WDM Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We investigate the efficient scheduling and access controlling mechanism for multiple types of real time service in WDM network. We classify the messages to four types and propose the scheduling mechanism for the periodic real time messages and a periodic real time messages. The method which surplus bandwidth fragments are used to transmit the a periodic messages is novel and increases the rates of utilization of channels. The classified scheduling schemes are compared and performances including the real time load rate and probability of the access control are obtained by the theory analysis and the example evaluation.

articleTitle: An Efficient Feature Redundancy Removal Approach towards Intrusion Detection in Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Intrusion detection is a critical component of secure information systems. Data Intrusion Detection Processing System often contains a lot of redundancy and noise features, bringing the system a large amount of computing resources, a long training time, a poor real-time, and a bad detection rate. For high dimensional data, feature selection can find the information-rich feature subset, thus enhance the classification accuracy and efficiency. Based on a improved feature selection algorithm, this paper proposes a lightweight intrusion detection model with computational efficiency and high detection accuracy. The algorithm is based on information gain and SVM. Its principle is to group all data features according to information gain, and then to choose the feature subset with the best classification accuracy according to SVM algorithm(the classification accuracy of SVM is defined as intrusion Detection accuracy). The experimental results demonstrated that our approach can find features subsets with higher classification accuracy compared with feature selection algorithm based on information gain and GA.

articleTitle: Design of an Application Cooperation Fair Congestion Control Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Network application cooperation fair congestion control (NACF) method is proposed for Internet congestion control. The basic idea of NACF is the coordination between network and application. The core mechanisms are hierarchical rate coding and dropping algorithm in network and the flow control by analyzing the acknowledged packets with rate code in application. the basic algorithm is introduced and the framed structure and functional model of the algorithm is described. Then, simulation analysis is made on the mechanism's performance and achieves satisfying result in realization of fairness and congestion control.

articleTitle: Self-Organized Algorithm Simulation for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor network is made up of a large number of sensor nodes in Ad Hoc mode to a network of self-organization, which integrates the sensors, micro-electromechanical systems, modern networking and wireless communications technologies, there are strong technological advantages and broad application prospects in the military, environment, health, family, space exploration and disaster rescue. In this paper, the latest progress of wireless sensor networks have been followed up, and the IDSQ (Information-driven sensor querying) algorithm is carried out a detailed description and analysis, and is simulated by MATLAB, we achieved effective tracking of moving targets in simulation results and obtained some meaningful conclusions.

articleTitle: A Study of Fuzzy Emotion Semantic Ontology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The fuzzy concept theory is applied in the emotion ontology library construction due to the emotion's fuzzy characteristic. This paper suggests a method of building emotion semantic ontology using the Fuzzy Formal Concept Analyzing (FFCA) theory. Then fuzzy emotion concept lattice is presented, which is on the basis of fuzzy emotion. Finally, a retrieval model in image semantic emotion is provided based on the former work. Related experiments were carried out of which the results validated the feasibility of this method on image emotional semantic search.

articleTitle: Improving the Scheduling Strategies in Dynamic Modeling by Using Compound Number
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The flexible scheduling of business process is crucial in the developing of enterprises, many researchers focus on the scheduling strategies, and many strategies were proposed. In this paper, eight classical scheduling strategies were introduced simply. The definition and some properties of compound number were mentioned in some short. We mainly discussed the application of the scheduling strategies using compound number, and use a figure to illustrate the whole course of modeling in this way. It should be very useful for the enterprises to analyzing and optimizing the business process.

articleTitle: Review on Carbon Cycle of Terrestrial Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Terrestrial ecosystem carbon cycle plays an important role in global carbon cycle because of its complexity and uncertainty. Study on terrestrial ecosystem carbon cycle relates to global climate change and potential ways or means to address. This paper is attempting to provide an overview of mechanism and research method of terrestrial ecosystem carbon cycle and perspective of emphases and hotspots on the research terrestrial ecosystem carbon cycle. We conclude that it prospective to be researched in the application of science complexity to terrestrial ecosystem carbon cycle. Terrestrial ecosystem is an complex adaptive system. The inner interaction of ecosystem is the main driving force for the self-organization, complexity and order in the ecosystem. This paper discusses mechanism and development of ecosystem complexity, by applying the principle and methods of complexity science which is a new approach for understanding ecological and evolutionary problems.

articleTitle: Optimal Assignment of Delivery Capacity for Network with Constraint
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For scale-free networks, traffic flow moving freely on a complex network is important to its normal and efficient functioning. In order to enhance the network efficiency, for a capacity-limited network, in this paper, we propose a new distribution algorithm by introducing an adjustable parameter ß to control and distribute the delivery capacity of single node dynamically. The simulations reveal that there is an optimal parameter to make the delivery efficiency best. Finally, based on the relationship between degree and load distribution (we define load at each node as the accumulated total number of packets passing through that node when every pair of nodes send and receive a packet along the shortest paths), further analysis about the effectiveness is presented.

articleTitle: A Novel Object Tracking Algorithm Based on Point Pattern Matching
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a novel point pattern matching algorithm. Compared with most published works, the proposed algorithm is characterized by its outstanding real time performance, making it the only applicable algorithm for object tracking among the existing ones. Evolved with the definition of point pattern matching, analyzing the object tracking task, it presents a specific description of the novel algorithm. The experimental results validate its real time performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Risk Decision-Making for Purchasing Electricity in Multi-market on the Basis of Variance
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the risk management that electricity purchasers will face in power purchase of four markets under the framework of the electricity market, two purchasing electricity models about the restrictions or non-restriction are set up by means of Variance measuring risk. Meanwhile, this paper also proposes several feasible algorithms to minimize risks, including statistical genetic algorithms (SGA) on the basis of historic data. Lastly, a simulation-sample for one of models is given in this essay.

articleTitle: Interval Estimation of Data Series with Poor Information Using Fuzzy Norm Method
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the fuzzy set theory and the norm theory, the fuzzy norm method is proposed to solve some of problems about interval estimation under the condition of poor information system with unknown probability distributions and small samples. By extracting difference value information from data series, the membership function and empirical distribution function are defined with a minimum of the maximum norm, thus the estimated interval of poor information system are obtained, having the over 95% confidence level and the below 15% relative error.

articleTitle: Explanation on Regional Productivity of China with Malmquist Index
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Malmquist Productivity Index and the data of 29 provinces of China within the period of 1991-2007, this paper decomposes the changes of TFP (TFP-ch) into technical changes (TECH-ch) and technical efficiency changes (TE-ch), and makes a further analysis on the convergence of technical efficiency among different sections. The conclusions are as following: (1) In all of the eastern, mid and western part of China, TFP-ch and TECH-ch turned from increase to decrease around the year of 1997, but TE-ch was continuously decrease. (2) TECH-ch explained 75% regional divergence of TFP-ch, and the left 25% was explained by TE-ch. Changes of TFP and its elements before 1997 were helpful to subtract the regional divergence, but after 1997 they went to the contrast. (3) TE-chamong all of the 29 provinces or that among the provinces within each of the eastern, the mid or the western part takes on an emanative trend.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation on Credit Risk of Power Customers Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Power supply enterprises for avoiding the customer credit risks which exist in management, should establish the analysis model of customer credit risk analysis model, carries on the effective appraisal to the customer credit risks. This article used AHP to determine each evaluating indicator's weight in the customer risk, used the method of the fuzzy quality synthetic evaluation to carry on risk assessment. The combination of the analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation establishes the mathematical model of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation about risk real estate development, which offers a combination of qualitative and quantitative analysis for the assessment of customer credit risks.

articleTitle: A Method Based on Area Histogram for Coarse Carbides Classification in High Speed Tool Steel
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Manual methods are used to perform the classification of coarse carbides in high speed tool steel these days, so a quantitative standard is demanded necessarily to achieve the automatic classification. In order to obtain the standard and further perform processing and analysis of carbide metallograph, area histogram used in image retrieval is first introduced to metallographic analysis field. Average area histogram(AAH)and prominent area histogram¿PAH¿ of different levels high-speed steel carbide spectrum are computed, and then the relationship between AAH&PAH and the distribution of carbide is found. Because a large number of small carbides on the calculation of AAH generated interference, the calculation result is not satisfactory so filter coefficients is put forward and used to remove the impact of small pieces of carbides on analysis results. Filter coefficients is further discussed by means of experiments results and AAH&PAH which are regarded as a quantitative standard of the automatic classification are calculated based on the best filter coefficient .

articleTitle: The VoIP Model Research Based on Finite Birth-Death Processes in Multi-channel Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In multi-hop wireless networks, using single-channel with single-transceiver over MAC protocol will generate instability of TCP throughput and serious unfair henomenon. Fortunately the situation can be greatly improved by the use of multi-channel model. In this paper, we established a model under limited-state Markov chain, focusing on the channel utilization, average queue time and average queue length in a given client count and the number of channel available to analyze the VoIP Quality-of-Service in detail. With Monte-Carlo Method to validate, we conclude that multi-channel model can significantly improve the overall of network capacity.

articleTitle: A Design of Secure Access Gateway Moving the Control Terminal Down to the Layer 2 Switches
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper reports put forward a research about secure access gateway based on moving the control terminal down to the layer 2 switches through the analysis of the actual network condition in university, and design a 24 ports hardware product by using embedded NAT processing unit. After a year of online testing, this product achieves in the function of address translation, access control, user binding, virus control, internet authentication and equipment management on the whole.

articleTitle: Research on an Environment-Friendly Automated Equipment Applied to Hot-Phosphating for Drill Collar Coupling Screw Thread
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the present situations and requirements of the hot-phosphating for the oil drill collar coupling screw thread, one type of environment-friendly automated equipment has been studied, the corresponding hot-phosphating process has been consummated and one new implementation scheme has been designed in which some key technologies such as total-closed circuit and autocontrol have been accomplished. Comparing with the open-type phosphating trough instrument, this equipment has total-closed structure in which all function solutions such as degreasing and descaling, surface conditioning, phosphating, passivation and cleaning can circulate continuously which means phosphating solution is easy to maintain and there is no pollution to it and its service life is prolonged accordingly, all that avoid the glaring drawbacks in open-style one. In addition, this device has low processing and operating cost, efficiency is high and the quality of the phosphating coat is reliable. Specially, there is no harm to environment and operators. And the control system is based on PLC which is applied usually in industrial control, it is easy to build and has reliable performance. The whole installation needs a low capital investment relatively and is operated and maintained simply and conveniently which implies a widespread application in drill collar coupling screw thread hot-phosphating.

articleTitle: A Decoupling Approach to Business Component Identification
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Effective Business Component Identification (BCI) is important to the success of Component-Based Information System Development (CBISD). In this paper, a BCI approach based on decoupling analysis is presented. Based on Business Process Graph (BPG), the approach makes use of graph partitioning to identify coupling business process subsets and transforms them into the corresponding business components. According to the relations between coupling business process subsets, the relations of business components are derived. The approach reduces the coupling between components and improves the cohesion of the individual components. Moreover, it creates the intelligible mapping between business processes and business components, and improves the understandability of component identification results. An application case is provided to test the approach.

articleTitle: The Knowledge Collaboration Effects of R&D Project Team
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the factors which influence the effects of knowledge collaboration in the knowledge collaboration process of R&D project team. Furthermore, through the study of knowledge collaboration theory and bloom's taxonomy, the algorithm of knowledge collaboration effects between the members of the R&D project team is presented. Finally, a case is given to illustrate the algorithm in detail.

articleTitle: Individual Encryption and Watermarking for Protecting Video on the Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A combined scheme of individual encryption and watermarking is presented to protect the copyright of the video programs on the public networks. The video program file is split into two files, one is the key file composed of DCT's DC coefficients in I-frames, and the other is a normal file composed of the rest. Then the watermarked key files are produced by embedding every user's identity into the key file respectively. At last the key data file for a user is published after encrypting with the distinct content key from other users'. In this scheme, the content key of one user is no use for others, and the cracker can be detected from the piracy copies according to the watermark embedded. At the same time, users can get the normal file from P2P networks with high speed.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Mode Decision for H.264 Based on Macroblock Motion Classification
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The H.264/AVC achieves higher compression efficiency than previous video coding standards. However, the full RD cost calculations for all intra-prediction modes and exhaustive searches for optimal motion vectors for variable block sizes result in extremely high computation complexity, which obstruct it from practical use. In this paper, an efficient algorithm is proposed to reduce the complexity of macroblock mode decision. Firstly, the proposed algorithm is to identify the boundary region and the interior region of the motion object by using the motion vectors information. Secondly, the boundary region was classified into two types of regions by the coded modes information. After that we process the different region distinctly. Experimental results show that the algorithm can save the encoding time up to 68% on average compared to the conventional method in the JVT JM8.6 reference encoder at the cost of negligible performance degradation.

articleTitle: On the Digital Development of Mountain-Based World Cultural Heritage Sites in China
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The interaction between information technology and tourism has brought fundamental changes in tourism practices. In recent year, digital development of mountain-based world cultural heritage sites has become a new trend. However, the theoretical research on this theme is rare. On this basis, this thesis firstly proposes its concept and targets, analyzes the situations of digital development for 7 mountain-based world cultural heritage sites in China. At last, it comes up with new development paths from digital information sharing, virtual scenic spots establishing, wireless network applying, and professional talents cultivating aiming at enhancing the digitization of mountain-based world cultural heritage sites in China, and promoting scientific utilization and protection of resources and environment.

articleTitle: An Improved Anonymous Remote Authentication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Diffie-Hellman key exchange protocol, an improved remote authentication protocol for value-added services in mobile networks is proposed, with the help of smart card and client account index. The improved scheme which inherits client anonymity and non-repudiation from previous identity-based remote authentication schemes is more efficient without trusted third party and bilinear pairing.

articleTitle: Double Close Loop Electrode Regulator System Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Electrode regulator system of ore smelting electric arc furnace is a nonlinear, multivariate, parameter-time-varying system, and its accurate mathematics model, inter-disturbance and outer-disturbance are unstable, so it is put forward a method of active disturbance rejection control strategy measure. Design an electrode disturbance rejection controller which is independent from object model, and correct its parameter. The outstretched state monitor of active disturbance rejection controller can monitor system state and outstretched state at real time, thus it fulfills the feedback of the whole state, compensation control of instability and outer-disturbance of system. Comparing this system with traditional single close loop constant current control system, it increases electrode place loop. The simulation experiment proves that this system is not only having strong robustness, but also having strong inhibition force for inter and outer-disturbance, besides that it has superior active performance.

articleTitle: Flight Simulation Testbed of Unmanned Helicopter
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper designed a flight simulation testbed of unmanned helicopter. This testbed has the advantage of simple structure, easy implement, low cost, convenient movement and so on. It is suitable for various flight test of mini-unmanned helicopter. It provides attitude needed by unmanned helicopter, such as pitch, yaw, roll and so on, to ensure that unmanned helicopter can be free flight within a certain range. Making use of the testbed can reproduce the actual flight of unmanned helicopter under laboratory conditions, and can be very convenient for attitude control, flight control, navigation and other scientific researches; accordingly, it ensures the security of flight test for unmanned helicopter.

articleTitle: Procedure for Traditional Enterprises Developing E-commerce Strategies: Efficient Guideline for Doing E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The proposed strategic procedure in the paper should provide a guideline for enterprises to develop their E-commerce strategy. It has been compiled by the author's training and experience of both management and technical issues. Six general steps are mainly discussed in this procedure: Making the initial decision to offer E-Commerce, Identifying the business aims for E-Commerce, Analyzing the feasibility of the E-Commerce initiative, Planning and design of E-commerce, Implementation, Strategy assessment. Currently this procedure has been developed into a decision pack and has been distributed to traditional enterprises for use as a guide for producing a well defined strategy.

articleTitle: The Formative Mechanism of Marketing Capability: The View of Organizational Learning and Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper synthesizes multidisciplinary theories, roundly teases the theoretical foundation of marketing capability, further perfects its conceptual system, and studies the formative mechanism of marketing capability based on the discussion of its fountainhead. As a conclusion, this paper indicates that marketing capability theory is gradually cognized and utilized based on resource and competence theories, and suggests companies to strengthen their organizational learning and knowledge management to improve their marketing capabilities.

articleTitle: A Common Information Infrastructure for Multi Command Center System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, various natural and social security problems are happening with increasing frequency. Many provinces' governments begin to construct emergency command system. Most of these command system constructed base on original sub-systems. Because these sub-systems use private protocol, use different data management program. It's difficult to share information between these sub-systems. Current solution is to create a top level command centers to manage and schedule all sub-systems. This solution is easy and cheap to construct, but it has many defeats. It's difficult to share information between sub-systems. It's difficult to re-use information under the condition of sub-system command system crashed. It's difficult to develop software under so many private protocols. In this paper, we present a new information infrastructure for emergency command system. This system provide a common information store and query interface, all command center with proper access rights can query data from this system. Using this information infrastructure, each sub-system command center can update to emergency command center in emergency condition. As a result, the sub-system can share information accurately and quickly. And it's easy to develop application under these common message exchange infrastructure.

articleTitle: Application of Probability Rough Set to Product Model Selection
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Probability rough set is applied to product model selection, risk type decision making problem is converted to probability rough set model for analysis, further, minimum risk decision making rule is found. Take a furniture factory in Foshan City of Guangdong Province as an example, this model is applied to furniture color selection, as provides a scientific decision making method for this factory in furniture color selection.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Fast Bit Synchronization Based on π/4-DQPSK in Underwater Acoustic Communication
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper draws on a bit synchronization algorithm used for terrestrial wireless communications π/4-DQPSK modulation mode and shapes the algorithm based on the characteristics of the Doppler effect of underwater acoustic channel. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm is more robust against the Doppler effect of underwater acoustic channel while maintaining the good performance of the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the Traffic Impact Analysis of the Second Ring Road in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In traffic fields of the ring road traffic influents, the main researches are often concentrated in researching the local traffic influence form traffic aspect, or researching how to improve and optimize the ring roads, and the other impacts from economics and environments aspects and so on. In this paper, we studied the traffic impacts from the whole aspect through building a simplified the ring road system model so that we can clear the effects of it more visually, what's more, the negative effects. It makes people see the negative effects of the ring road which they were often ignored.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction Technology of Random Vibration Signal Based on Singular Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Structural random vibration effective information extraction is one of the most important issues to study the dynamic characteristics of engineering structures. Combined with singular entropy theory, an effective method of noise reduction for random vibration signal is put forward. Construct analog signal with varying degrees of noise, and the noise is reduced based on the wavelet method, IIR numeric filter, and singular entropy technique separately, and also the SNR index is calculated separately after noise reduction. Study shows that this method can determine the proper order of singular spectrum of the random vibration signal, and ensure the integrity of information contained in the signal after noise reduction and the maximum SNR improvement to a large extent. This is essential to extract the accurate signal feature and reliable analysis.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of System Monitoring Component of Workload Adaptation Framework in Autonomic DBMSs
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The workload adaptation is a performance management process in autonomic database management system (DBMS). In the workload adaptation framework, the system monitoring component monitors the database resources consumption at SQL command level, and feed back the monitoring information to other related components in this framework. This paper analyzes the functional structure of the system monitoring component, and studies the implementation method. How to reduce the resources consumption of database induced by the monitoring component is partially considered in this paper. Experiments with Oracle 10 are conducted to show the effectiveness of the design and implementation.

articleTitle: On Methods of Transfer as a Learning Based on Artifical Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies learning transfer based on the adaptive learning theory, intelligence cognitive model theory and knowledge input theory under the large framework of updated cognitive theory of psychology. It mainly focuses on the method and experiment of positive transfer in production system self-adaptability model with the help of updated Artificial Neural Networks communication technology. These methods can help provide students with strategies in coping with their learning so that they could become self-directed learners through the guilded adaptive learning and intelligence teaching.

articleTitle: A Topology Partition Algorithm Based on Link Coarsening in Parallel Network Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Today's networks are facing more and more serious large-scale network attack such as worm and botnet. While such attacks can't and shouldn't be reproduced in the real network, network simulation is become more and more popular during the research. As the prerequisite of network simulation, topology partition influences the performance of simulation significantly. We suggest a new topology partition algorithm in parallel network simulation. This algorithm is a kind of agglomerative hierarchical clustering methods based on link coarsening. The experiment shows that our algorithm can finish partition on current computers in acceptable time for even around millions of vertices. Furthermore, the links between different sub-domains are fewer and the connectivity in each sub-domain is also guaranteed. Compared with the results of KMETIS, the new algorithm can reduce the edgecut more than 90% in general.

articleTitle: Two Styles of Game Analysis between Environmental Protection Department and Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, China has faced serious environmental problems. The pollution from the manufacturer has a bad effect on the environment. Thinking of the high interest, a great many manufacturers don't want to take action to protect the environment, what's worse, even some of the manufacturers have cheated the environmental protection department. Under this condition, it is a considerable problem that which measures will environmental protection department chooses to solve the condition. This paper gives two styles of game analysis models.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Nonbinary LDPC Code Based on Finite Fields
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The encoding and decoding of binary LDPC codes are expanded using characteristics of the Finite Fields concept, a nonbinary LDPC code encoding and decoding method based on the Finite Fields are investigated and the computational complexity of this algorithm is estimated, providing a foundation for the practical applications of this method. Then this algorithm is compared with the binary algorithm. The results show that its performance is superior to the binary BP iterative algorithm. Finally, the effects of the relevant factors such as the number of iterations selected, the structure of the check matrix etc on the algorithm performance were analyzed.

articleTitle: Trusted Evolutionary Algorithm for Global Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the initial population is generated by orthogonal design method which can generate a uniformly distributed initial population in the search space, and a new crossover operator based on Latin square design and an approximate method of principle component analysis is presented. The approximate method first determine the sensitive components and then the crossover operator is mainly used to these components. As a result, the crossover operator has the ability of local search and thus can exploit the search space efficiently. Furthermore, a mutation operator based on quantization is presented. Based on these, a trusted evolutionary algorithm for no differentiable global optimization is proposed and its global convergence can be guaranteed, which indicated the proposed algorithm is trusted. At last, the numerical simulations are made for some standard test functions. The performance of the proposed algorithm is compared with that of two widely-cited algorithms. The results indicate the proposed algorithm is effective and has better performance than the compared algorithms for these test functions.

articleTitle: Study on the Information Service System for Rural Off-Farm Employee Based on Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There is an urgent need for the government to provide effective off-farm employment services for rural labors. Because of weak information characteristics, the rural labors can't get off-farm employee service information effectively and timely. The aim of this paper is establishing rural off-farm employee information service system (ROFEISS)based short message delivery. First, this paper gives the organization structure of ROFEISS, it is consisted of five parts. Second, gives the procedure of information collecting, processing, storage and delivery. Third, describes the design content of ROFEISS including function analysis, process flow design and network model. Then analyzes the existed problems of ROFEISS. Finally is the conclusion.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cosine Window Functions by Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed an evolutionary method to optimizing the cosine window family by using Differential Evolution (DE). First, the classic cosine windows such as Hamming window and Blackman window are optimized. Results show better performance in terms of side-lobe level and roll-off ratio for the same main-lobe width. Then, a series of optimized six order cosine windows are provided and their performances are analyzed. The comparison proves that the proposed method is an effective approach for the design of window functions.

articleTitle: Mobile Conference Scheme Based on Verifiable Random Number
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The previous conference schemes for mobile communications focus on establishment, distributing and updating of shared key for conferees, which cannot prevent conferees from submitting fraud message or invalid message. The improvement scheme based on verifiable random number which is constructed with interpolating polynomial reduces the probability of rubbish information in the mobile conference greatly.

articleTitle: The Comprehensive Application Study of GRA and ISM in System Structure Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Interpretative Structural Modeling (ISM) is an effective approach to analyze the complex system structure. The adjacency matrix represents the relations between and among system elements and the system digraph can be drawn by deduction of the reachability matrix. The adjacency matrix is usually built by experts' experience. Because the process does not take the corresponding data of system elements into account, the adjacency matrix is lack of objectivity and accuracy. In this paper, the adjacency matrix is built using grey relational analysis (GRA). The grey incidence matrix is derived considering the relevant behavioral sequences as referential behavior sequence in turn and the system digraph is drawn using ISM. The paper gives the theoretical deduction and the specific calculation steps of the above approach. The validity of the method is verified by the application of China's water transport system.

articleTitle: Study on Reverse Logistics in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of economy, the environment protection consciousness of people is strengthening. To solve the problem of global resource shortage and the pollution, more and more enterprises begin to carry the reverse logistics into execution. This paper firstly introduces literature review of reverse logistics, subsequently explains management process of reverse logistic, and considers the resources recycling in the stage of products' conception and designing and to raise efficiency of resources, at last this paper shows that building the recycling logistics system including the forward logistics and the reverse logistics together will be the direction of manufacturing enterprises development in the future. In summary, this paper can shed light on future research direction in development of reverse logistics.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Task-Oriented Service Platform for Battlefield Environment Information
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High performance, dynamic customization, and automatization had become new requirements for the battlefield environment support system in the high-tech local wars, so task-oriented service platform for battlefield environment information(TSPBEI) need to be realized. Firstly, A task-oriented integration framework was established, which supporting multi-source data integrated accessing, task and data flow dynamic customization and analysis functions dynamic composition. Secondly, some main subsystems, including its data integration subsystem, process integration subsystem and application integration subsystem, are designed detailedly. Finally, a prototype system was realized to validate correctness and feasibility of the theory and method initially.

articleTitle: A Rapid Decision-Making Model in Supply Chain Finance Emergency Based on GDSS
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve the rapid and effective decision-making mechanism to play down the loss to the minimum in supply chain finance emergency, a collaborative decision-making model is used in this paper. It analyses the decision-making demand of emergency as scientific, rapid and effective, and gives modeling method, rapid decision-making flow and major processes to achieve decision-making demand. Then it sets up a fuzzy of multi-objectives many-persons decision makings model with examples, and adopts set pair analysis as the method for consensus evaluation. Final, a model based on GDSS is pointed out to realize effective decision-making.

articleTitle: Theoretic Thought on the Constraints of Information Quality under Network Information-Sharing Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because of special characteristics of information quality (IQ) in the network information-sharing, the information quality management (IQM) generally is lack of a perfect and systematic theory and method that can be accepted extensively, the existing IQM theory can seldom guide effectively IQM work in the practice of network information-sharing. That makes the IQM in the network information-sharing lack of unified standards for measurement and guidance of quality control. By using constraints of information quality (CIQ) concept, this paper has carried on a kind of helpful theory to explore on IQ and existing analysis under the network information-sharing environment, and enable to form a unified understanding. This will be beneficial to take the new thinking of quality control, method and measure to carry on IQ improvement, and make it better in problem solution in practice.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Development Strategy Efficiency of Small and Medium-Sized Commercial Bank Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper defines the concept and characteristics of small and medium commercial banks based on the evolution history of bank, from the present financing difficulties of SMEs status of research and development strategies to small and medium commercial banks, put forward three development strategies: restructuring, expansion and localization, and each development strategies chooses three, a total of nine samples of small and medium commercial banks. The empirical research on their profitability and operation management capabilities two aspects based on DEA. The results show that localization strategy is more efficient than the other two development strategies, which provides a theoretical basis for the development of small and medium commercial banks to provide loans to SMEs and on this basis put forward development strategies and suggestions of small and medium commercial banks.

articleTitle: Algorithm Research for Mining Maximal Frequent Itemsets Based on Item Constraints
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Frequent item mining has been extensively used in association rules mining. The goal of frequent itemset mining is to discover all the itemsets whose supports in the database exceed a user-specified threshold. However, it often generates a large number of candidate itemset, which reduce the effectiveness of the mining algorithms. Constraint-based mining enables users to provide restraints on mining their interested association rules and can greatly improve the efficiency of mining tasks. In this paper, we propose a fast constraint-based algorithm for mining maximal frequent itemsets. The algorithm introduces item-constraints into the Eclat algorithm, and adopts itemset extension pruning strategy to prun search space. Empirical evaluation showed that the algorithm is very effective and can solve the lack of constrained frequent itemsets algorithm in mining long pattern and intensive database.

articleTitle: Estimating Upper Bound of Duration for Instances of Generalized Well-Formed Workflow
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Estimating upper bound of duration for workflow instances is essential in workflow scheduling. Current researches on this topic omitted the fact that, if a workflow net contains selective patterns, then when an instance of which run to a particular time point, it's possible that some unexecuted activities are bypassed and have no chance to be executed by this instance. Therefore, upper bound of duration of workflow instance must be computed only based on task subnet that consists of executed activities and unexecuted ones that are possible to be executed. In this paper, rules were proposed to build reachable subnets for instances of generalized well-formed workflow, and the complex problem of estimating upper bound of duration for such subnets was decomposed into simpler ones for instance subgraphs. Also, an algorithm to estimating upper bound of duration for workflow instance was proposed and an example was put forward to illustrate the process.

articleTitle: An Ontology-Based General Multi-scale Conceptual Model and its 3D GIS Application
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important characteristic of geo-spatial elements, scale has become an important aspect in GIS study. However, the existing algorithms mainly solve scale generalization problems of some specific types of data in 2D, which are not suitable for multi-elements integration of general GIS environment, especially in 3D GIS. With the help of ideas and methods relevant to ontology, the ontological significance of the general multi-scale conceptual model is analyzed, and a scale-extended geographic ontology structure is defined. Through mining the domain essential content of geo-spatial elements multi-scale generalization, the functional classification and the definition of scale behavior operators are proposed. A general conceptual model is established in the form of category-operator-data-relation quadruple which is explained at the application ontology level. In order to apply automatic generalization with the model, an Agent model is adapted, as well as its processing. At the end, an example is put up to show an intuitionistic scale generalization process in a typical 3D GIS environment. The conceptual model is adaptive for different kinds of 3D geo-spatial elements, and the new Agent-based multi-scale generalization method is effective and fully automatic in 3D GIS applications.
